extras: Freemium: recording is limited to 1 minute in the free version, with a premium 5-minute tier listed as coming soon. A roadmap lists planned features (offline Whisper, mobile UI). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Most Obsidian voice note tools record audio only. SpeakNote converts your audio automatically into clean, usable notes.
problem: Obsidian can record audio clips but cannot turn them into searchable Markdown text, so voice notes stay unsearchable and unusable for writing workflows.
